ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOB=30^\circ$, $\angle AOE=140^\circ$, $OB$ bisects $\angle AOC$, and $OD$ bisects $\angle AOE$. What is the measure of $\angle AOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the given, \\
since $\angle AOB = 30^\circ$ and OB bisects $\angle AOC$, \\
it follows that $\angle AOC = 2\angle AOB = 2 \times 30^\circ = \boxed{60^\circ}$.
